title: Four small items: the opening measured for a CLEAN and a WRECK landing, ?skip=dog, SOL's automated beam on the tank, and the 31,018 kg reading
context: Follow-ups from the 2026-11-12 economy and recon-dog rounds on branch small-items from c8c4be48: only the automatic landing (HARD) had been measured at THE FIRST ORDERS; the owner wanted a replay point at the card; SOL's beam is the one automated weapon whose footprint lists the tank (src/fx/laser-arsenal.js candidates, LASER_BURN.tank 1 s); an earlier --grow session had read 31,018 kg from the HUD.
outcome: (1) --dog-scout GRADE=CLEAN|HARD|WRECK (flown by the --landing suite's scripted pilot, stops at the card, prints OPENING GRADES): salvage / bank at the card, CLEAN 2,400 / 3,080 (all four cards, all six pairs); HARD 1,800 / 2,484 (all six pairs); WRECK 960 / 1,646 (all four cards single; four of six pairs: rotor+pad 1,050, rotor+foundry 850, pad+foundry 1,000, foundry+solar 1,600; rotor+solar 1,650 is 4 kg over, pad+solar 1,800 over). A WRECK affords every card alone and no pair with the pad and the array together. The rover's first pour was 380-386 kg on these runs (320-324 on 2026-11-12). (2) ?skip=dog (STORY_CHAPTER_DOG, src/content/story-defaults.js): the opening at THE FIRST ORDERS' card with the gate and depot standing, the Rotor on its socket, the Stålheart unprinted, the bank derived from content (HARD salvage 1,800 + two surveys 300 + DOG_SCOUT.harvest.poured 380 = 2,480); the card reads TUTORIAL 4/6 QUIVER; the beats treat a start at orders as the dog's (story-beats scouting), the card waits for the arrival's late models (arrival.loading) because a paused page never swaps the rocket. --chapters covers it (PASS 8 pages). (3) --sol-ff: tank beside the gate breach with 40 bodies kept up, SOL-88 on auto for 150 s (5 passes, 75 s of burn, 215 aims): 0 aims whose footprint held the tank (closest aim 34.1 m, the guard is footprint 8 + safeMetres 25 = 33 m), 0 burnTank, 0 hull hits from SOL, the hull present on all 2,572 footprint frames; with the hull teleported onto the beam's contact every 0.7 s (worst case of driving in) 800 footprint frames held the tank, the beam let go 104 times, 0 burnTank (the 1.0 s dwell is never reached). SOL does not hit the tank on auto, so no game change. SOL's candidates do not list the rover, companions or mechs, so it cannot damage them either. (4) The 31,018 is a reading artifact of the suite: #td-stats textContent joins the hull count span to the bank with no separator ('HEART ♥3' + '1018kg'); the real bank was 1,018 kg. state().biomass and .hud-biomass agree at every --grow step (0, 1,800, 2,100, 2,436). Not a game bug, nothing changed.
alternatives: A separate --opening-grades suite: rejected, an env switch on --dog-scout reuses the drive, the hands and the card block in one place.
?skip=dog as the seventh tutorial chapter: rejected, it would renumber the card's 1/6..6/6; it is a record beside STORY_CHAPTER_END that reads as the QUIVER's.
Putting the rover's pour in the chapter as a second copy of 2,420: rejected, the bank is derived from LANDING_GAME.salvage, DOG_SCOUT.points and survey.pay, with the pour as the one measured number.
Extending SOL's friend list with the rover, companions and mechs: not done, the measurement shows no hit on the tank and SOL cannot burn those units.
evidence: .superpowers/small-items/grade-CLEAN.log, grade-WRECK.log, grade-HARD.log (OPENING GRADES lines; GRADE=... scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --dog-scout)
